user.title: Create an observe-only scheduler
user.description: Starts in observe-only mode: existing heating controls stay in charge. Add zones, review the proposed schedules and smart modes in the companion card. Heating commands require explicit control-mode activation after a reviewed handover. Use a separate test instance for this development build.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one scheduler instance is supported.

user.title: Add a heating zone
user.description: Choose a single-target heating climate entity. Review limits and an initial baseline in its unit (Celsius or Fahrenheit). The baseline fills all seven days until edited. These are application bounds, not a protection guarantee. If heating control is already enabled for the scheduler, new enabled zones also participate. An optional existing boost timer establishes external ownership; configure its adapter in the card Settings.

data.name: Zone name
data.manual_policy: Resume after an observed manual target change
data.manual_minutes: Hold duration in minutes (duration policy only)

settings.title: Zone settings
settings.description: Keep the same thermostat and units; create a new zone to replace a device. Limits must accommodate schedules, holds and smart-mode targets. Manage boost ownership and timer changes in the companion card Settings. If control mode is enabled, these settings can affect heating after reload.

data.name: Zone name
data.baseline_temperature: Initial baseline (does not overwrite saved schedules)
data.manual_policy: Resume after an observed manual target change
data.manual_minutes: Hold duration in minutes (duration policy only)

schedule.title: Edit preview week
schedule.description: Use the companion card for visual editing, or supply exactly mon through sun here. Each day contains ordered periods with start (HH:MM), temperature and optional label, beginning at 00:00. Ends follow the next start; the last extends to 24:00. Saving re-evaluates heating if control mode is enabled. Close without submitting to cancel.

resume.title: Clear preview manual hold?
resume.description: This clears only the scheduler's stored manual hold. It will not switch on heating or cancel an external boost. A physically off thermostat stays off.

error.invalid_zone: Check the thermostat is available, supports heat with a single target, is not mapped twice, and has reviewed limits/targets matching its capabilities. Existing schedules and holds must also fit new limits. When replacing a device, create a new zone.
error.invalid_schedule: Supply a complete valid week with ordered unique starts, a 00:00 baseline for each day, and temperatures within this zone's limits/increment. If another editor saved first, close and reopen this editor to refresh its revision.
error.save_failed: Storage could not be saved. Nothing was committed; check storage and try again.

abort.schedule_saved: Schedule saved. Heating follows the selected control mode.
abort.preview_resumed: Stored manual hold cleared. A physically off thermostat stays off.
